# Waynur

> Waynur is AI school management software for private schools across India, built around WhatsApp. Parents get absence, homework, exam result and fee updates on the school's own WhatsApp number with no app to install. Made by Wayne E Solutions, Ludhiana, Punjab, India.

- Pricing: per student per year, billed to the school; parents never pay. Waynur Core ₹400 per student per year; Waynur AI ₹650 per student per year (adds the AI tutor and AI tools); prices plus GST
- Data hosted in India; DPDP Act 2023; role-based access and audit logs
- Most schools go live within a week
- Contact: info@waynur.com
